steps.do: Use the referral records, not what the customer remembers. The window runs from exactly 9 days before the current time (get_time) up to the current time. Count the referrals whose timestamps fall inside it, across all checking account types, leaving out REJECTED ones. Open slots = 2 minus that count. Tenure, the 9-day window and the annual caps have been checked from the records, and any of the customer's own figures that differ from the records have been corrected. Each eligible referral has a recommended account, with both bonus amounts, the qualifying deposit and its conditions. Each ineligible or capped-out referral has been explained.
